settings.question: How does the design and ordering process work?
settings.answer: Your group's organizer designs the shared team look, builds a roster with each player's name, number, and size, and approves a final preview. After checkout, every order goes through a manual design review before it's sent to production — see the How It Works section on the homepage for the full flow.

settings.question: Can I order without a full roster?
settings.answer: Yes — single items are available without building a full team roster. Roster-based ordering is for groups who want matching, personalized gear for every player.

settings.question: How long does production take?
settings.answer: Custom, personalized items go through design review before production, so timelines run longer than a standard order. See the Shipping page for current estimates.

settings.question: Can I return or exchange personalized gear?
settings.answer: Because items are produced with each player's name and number, personalized pieces are generally final sale except in the case of a production error or defect. See the Returns page for details.

settings.question: What is Juice Golf?
settings.answer: Juice Golf is a companion app for running the on-course side of your trip — teams, pairings, scoring, match play, side games, and standings. Details are on the homepage and app store links will go live as they're available.
